Planning to marry Fatima, Ali arranged for a goldsmith of Bani Qainuqa to bring idhkhir with him and sell it to goldsmiths to pay for his wedding banquet.
The Prophet blesses Abdur-Rahman and tells him to give a banquet, even of one sheep; he gives one for Zainab, and Ansar women bless Aisha as a bride.
At the Prophet's wedding to Zainab, Um Sulaim's dish feeds batches of guests, and after some linger he recites the verse telling guests to disperse after eating.
After guests lingered at Zainab's wedding banquet the Hijab verses came; the Prophet's best banquet was one sheep for Zainab, others were of hais or barley.
Wedding invitations must be accepted, Ibn Umar going even when fasting; the worst feast invites only the rich; the Prophet would accept a trotter; Abu Usaid's bride served the guests.
At Abu Usaid's wedding his bride alone prepared and served the food and gave the Prophet a drink of dates soaked overnight.
